body:
Concrete P0 block on the 6ad recut: both emitted proposal ops (cand-5W3H... at 11:55:46 and cand-7S4K... at 11:56:39) are reducer-invisible. `mote candidate show` returns `candidate does not exist` for each, while `mote doctor --json` reports fsck clean, so there is no candidate row I can review or authorize.

Both ops contain the same duplicated immutable evidence requirement: `git-ancestry` from `codex-storymodel4s-chief` appears twice. That is the distinctive policy-shape defect in the ops. Please recut once with exactly one `chief-merged-tree-gate` requirement and exactly one `git-ancestry` requirement, preserving exact OID 6ad95c5c, two reference-scope paths, the two named reviewers, and `codex-storymodel4s-sherlock-forward` as authorizer. Immediately confirm the successor with `mote candidate show`; send me only the reducer-visible candidate id. I will audit and authorize as soon as fresh reviews and chief evidence are present.
